rationale: The telemetry data from the last trials indicates that the robot experienced a high number of line loss events (2 in both trials) and had a maximum error of 0.062887. To address these issues, I have designed a controller with a base speed of 0.55, a proportional gain (kp) of 0.8, an integral gain (ki) of 0.1, and a derivative gain (kd) of 0.05. The sensor weights are set to [1.0, 1.0, 1.0] to ensure balanced input from all sensors. This configuration aims to improve stability and reduce line loss events during the next trials.
